BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessageEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessageEvent

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThinkingEvent.description:

A progress signal, not a content carrier.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadContextCompa.description: Indicates that context compaction (summarization) occurred during the session.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAuto.title: BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAuto

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolResultEvent.description: Event representing the result of an agent tool execution.
BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolResultEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolResultEvent

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolUseEvent.description: Event emitted when the agent invokes a built-in agent tool.
BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolUseEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolUseEvent

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolsetDefaultConf.description: Resolved default configuration for agent tools.

A call the server cannot reach a judgement on evaluates to ask.

Client may send a new prompt.

BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusRetrying.description:
The server is retrying automatically.

BetaManagedAgentsSearchResultContent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSearchResultContent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionAgent.description:
Resolved `agent` definition for a `session`.

Snapshot of the `agent` at `session` creation time.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionAgent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionAgent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionBudgetReached.description: The agent stopped because the session's tracked list cost reached its budget, or because its usage includes a model with no list price (which the budget cannot measure). Raise the budget to continue — or, if raising is rejected because a model has no list price, remove the budget.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionBudgetReached.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionBudgetReached

BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent.description:
Emitted when a session has been deleted.

Terminates any active event stream — no further events will be emitted for this session.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionEndTurn.description: The agent completed its turn naturally and is ready for the next user message.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionEndTurn.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionEndTurn

BetaManagedAgentsSessionErrorEvent.description: An error event indicating a problem occurred during session execution.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionErrorEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionErrorEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagent202610.description: Resolved multiagent configuration with three members, as copied to the `session` at creation.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagent202610.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagent20261001

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentCoordi.description: Resolved coordinator topology with full agent definitions for each roster member.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentCoordi.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentCoordinator

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentSubage.description: The agent can spawn session threads.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentSubage.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentSubagentsEnabled

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentWorkfl.description: The agent can start workflow runs.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentWorkfl.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentWorkflowsEnabled

BetaManagedAgentsSessionRefusal.description: The turn ended because the model's response was refused, for example by a safety classifier.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionRefusal.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionRefusal

BetaManagedAgentsSessionRequiresAction.description: The agent is idle waiting on one or more blocking user-input events (tool confirmation, custom tool result, etc.). Resolving all of them transitions the session back to running.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionRequiresAction.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionRequiresAction

BetaManagedAgentsSessionRetriesExhausted.description: The turn ended because repeated errors exhausted the retry budget or an error escalated to `retry_status: 'exhausted'`.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionRetriesExhausted.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionRetriesExhausted

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent.description: Indicates the agent has paused and is awaiting user input.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusReschedule.description: Indicates the session is recovering from an error state and is rescheduled for execution.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusReschedule.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRescheduledEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEve.description: Indicates the session is actively running and the agent is working.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEve.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminated.description: Indicates the session has terminated, either due to an error or completion.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminated.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminatedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent.description:
Resolved `agent` definition for a single `session_thread`.

Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time. The multiagent roster is not repeated here; read it from `Session.agent`.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEve.description:
Emitted when a child thread is created.

Written to the parent thread's output stream so clients observing the session see child creation.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEve.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdle.description:
A session thread has yielded and is awaiting input.

Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdle.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdleEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusResc.description:
A session thread hit a transient error and is retrying automatically.

Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusResc.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRescheduledEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunn.description:
A session thread has begun executing.

Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunn.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunningEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerm.description:
A session thread has terminated and will accept no further input.

Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerm.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerminatedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent.description:
Emitted when an UpdateSession request changed at least one field.

Carries only the fields that changed; absent fields were not part of the update. The new configuration applies from the next turn.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent.description: Periodic snapshot of the session's cumulative usage and tracked list cost.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageSnapshot.description: Point-in-time snapshot of a session's cumulative usage.
BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageSnapshot.title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageSnapshot

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEven.description: Emitted when a model request completes.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEven.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEv.description: Emitted when a model request is initiated by the agent.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEv.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelUsage.description: Token usage for a single model request.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelUsage.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelUsage

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEn.description:
Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle completes.

Carries the verdict and aggregate token usage. A verdict of `needs_revision` means another evaluation cycle follows; `satisfied`, `max_iterations_reached`, `failed`, or `interrupted` are terminal — no further evaluation cycles follow.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEn.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEndEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOn.description:
Periodic heartbeat emitted while an outcome evaluation cycle is in progress.

Distinguishes 'evaluation is actively running' from 'evaluation is stuck' between the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` and `span.outcome_evaluation_end` events.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOn.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOngoingEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationSt.description: Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle begins.
BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationSt.title: BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationStartEvent

BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock.description: Content block in a mid-conversation system message. Text-only.
BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock.title: BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock

BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent.description:
A mid-conversation system message event.

Carries system-role content that is appended to the session as a `role: "system"` turn.
BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent

BetaManagedAgentsTextRubric.description: Rubric content provided inline as text.
BetaManagedAgentsTextRubric.title: BetaManagedAgentsTextRubric

BetaManagedAgentsThreadLimitWorkflowRunE.description: The run exceeded the limit on the number of threads that a run can create.
BetaManagedAgentsThreadLimitWorkflowRunE.title: BetaManagedAgentsThreadLimitWorkflowRunError

BetaManagedAgentsTimeoutWorkflowRunError.description: The run reached its time limit.
BetaManagedAgentsTimeoutWorkflowRunError.title: BetaManagedAgentsTimeoutWorkflowRunError

BetaManagedAgentsUnknownError.description:
An unknown or unexpected error occurred during session execution.

A fallback variant; clients that don't recognize a new error code can match on `retry_status` and `message` alone.
BetaManagedAgentsUnknownError.title: BetaManagedAgentsUnknownError

BetaManagedAgentsUnknownWorkflowRunError.description: A failure that has no type of its own.
BetaManagedAgentsUnknownWorkflowRunError.title: BetaManagedAgentsUnknownWorkflowRunError

BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEve.description: Event sent by the client providing the result of a custom tool execution.
BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEve.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEvent

BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent.description:
Echo of a `user.define_outcome` input event.

Carries the server-generated `outcome_id` that subsequent `span.outcome_evaluation_*` events reference.
BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent

BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent.description: An interrupt event that pauses agent execution and returns control to the user.
BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent

BetaManagedAgentsUserLocation.description: Approximate user location for search result localization.
BetaManagedAgentsUserLocation.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserLocation

BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent.description: A user message event in the session conversation.
BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEve.description: A tool confirmation event that approves or denies a pending tool execution.
BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEve.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEvent

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent.description:
Event sent by the client providing the result of an agent-toolset tool execution.

Only valid on `self_hosted` environments, where sandbox-routed tools are executed by the client rather than the server.
BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceAll.description: Every URL from this source may be fetched. This is the default.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceAll.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceAll

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceExcept.description: Every tool's results contribute URLs that may be fetched, except the named tools' results.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceExcept.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceExcept

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceNone.description: This source contributes no URLs that may be fetched.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceNone.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceNone

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceOnly.description: Only the named tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceOnly.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceOnly

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceToolRe.description: Names one tool in an only or except list.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceToolRe.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSourceToolReference

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSources.description:
Which sources contribute URLs the web_fetch tool may fetch.

A key that is null was not set and allows every URL from that source.
BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSources.title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchURLSources

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunCreatedEvent.description:
A workflow run was created.

A workflow run is background work that the session's agent starts. Emitted once per run, before the run's other `workflow_run.*` events.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunCreatedEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunCreatedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunErrorEvent.description:
A workflow run met an error, or an error kept a run from being created.

A run that ends with a `result.type` of `error` emits this event before its `workflow_run.status_ended`, with the same `error`.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunErrorEvent.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunErrorEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhase.description: A phase that a workflow run's plan declares.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhase.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhase

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEv.description:
A workflow run's plan left a phase, or the run's end closed it.

Emitted once for every `workflow_run.phase_started` event, before the run's `workflow_run.status_ended` event. The event does not say whether the plan finished the phase's work, or why it left.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEv.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseStarted.description: A workflow run's plan entered a phase.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseStarted.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseStartedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultComple.description:
The run's plan, a program that the agent wrote, finished.

This does not say whether the work succeeded.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultComple.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultCompleted

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultError.description: The run failed or reached its time limit.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultError.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultError

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusEndedE.description:
A workflow run ended.

Emitted once per run, as the last of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusEndedE.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusEndedEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusIdleEv.description:
A workflow run is idle.

Emitted each time the run goes idle, whatever the cause. If the run ends while idle, no `workflow_run.status_running` comes between this event and its `workflow_run.status_ended`.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusIdleEv.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusIdleEvent

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusRunnin.description:
A workflow run is running.

Emitted when the run starts to execute, and each time it resumes after being idle. A run that starts idle emits `workflow_run.status_idle` first.
BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusRunnin.title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusRunningEvent

BetaMonetaryAmount.description: A monetary amount in a specific currency.
BetaMonetaryAmount.title: BetaMonetaryAmount
